TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
  THURSDAY JANUARY 16, 2025 9:30 AM
  SAN DIMAS COUNCIL CHAMBER CONFERENCE ROOM
  245 EAST BONITA AVENUE

PLEASE NOTE: Traffic Safety Committee is an Advisory Committee which is open to the public. In order
to conduct the meeting effectively and fairly, participants will be given an opportunity to discuss their
concerns within a 3-minute time allotment. This timing has been instituted to ensure everyone wishing to
speak has the same opportunity. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation with this policy.

If you have any additional questions, please contact staff at (909) 394-6240 or email at
publicworks@sandimasca.gov.

COMMITTEE MEMBERS
Shari Garwick (Director of Public Works), Steve Barragan (Engineering Manager, Public Works Dept.),
Esau Ramos (Manager, Maintenance Yard), Detective Leo (San Dimas Sherriff’s Department) Ruben
Perales (Traffic Engineer), Rose Lee (BUSD Transportation Director), Genevieve Amaro (Management
Aide, Public Works Dept.)

INTRODUCTIONS

DISCUSSION ITEMS

 01-25-01 Gladstone Avenue & Walnut Avenue
 Request from Resident, review traffic intersection concern
 01-25-02 Puente St & Avenida Monte Vista/ Puente St & Via Esperanza intersection
 concerns
 Request from Resident, review traffic intersection concern
 01-25-03 Revise Current TSC Form & move meetings to Wednesday
 Request from Staff, review and revise current Traffic Safety Committee request form
 01-25-04 W Gladstone Avenue Regarding Buses & Trucks
 Request from Resident, review traffic concern regarding buses and trucks traveling on
 Gladstone Avenue

CONTINUED ITEMS
   03-24-06 Oakway Ave & Ghent Ave
  Request from Resident, review and consider stop signs to be installed at Oakway Ave and Ghent Ave.
  09-24-05 Ekstrand Elementary
  Request by BUSD, to review intersection of Juanita and Basilio due to near miss of student in
  crosswalk
  09-24-10 Valley Center Ave between Gainsborough Road & Silver Bit Court
  Request by Resident, review reckless driving concerns on Valley Center Ave.
  OFF AGENDA ITEM

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

  Notice Regarding Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance
  with the ADA, if you need assistance to participate in a city meeting,
  please contact the City Clerk's Office at (909) 394-6216. Early
  notification before the meeting you wish to attend will make it possible
  for the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to
  this meeting [28 CFR 35.102-35.104 ADA Title II].

Copies of documents distributed for the meeting are available in alternative formats upon request. Any
writings or documents provided to the Traffic Safety Committee regarding any item on this agenda will be
made available for public review Monday through Thursday 7:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. and on Fridays from
7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. at the Public Works Department. In addition, most documents are posted on the
City's  website  at  www.sandimasca.gov.

Posting Statement: I declare under penalty of perjury that on January 13, 2025, I posted a true and correct
copy of this agenda on the bulletin board in the Civic Center Plaza of City Hall at 245 E. Bonita Ave., and
on  the  City's  website  www.sandimasca.gov/agendas-minutes/as  required  by  law.

  Genevieve Amaro, Managment Aide
January 13, 2025  Genevieve Amaro, Management Aide

  Attachments not included.
